summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K with a press release dated October 2, 2026, disclosing that Pure Tungsten Inc. published a corrective disclosure and settled Almonty's Ontario Superior Court action filed October 10, 2025. The settlement confirms Tiger Kim never held any executive, officer, or director role at Almonty; his independent contractor role ended December 31, 2015. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report on a legal settlement and disclosure correction, not a special situation. No deal terms, no board recommendation, and no advisor were named. Watch for confirmation of settlement terms and any residual reputational or legal risk.
